summary: Fifth Third Bancorp filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, announcing a notice to Wilmington Trust Company, as trustee, to redeem all $500 million principal amount of its outstanding 1.707% Fixed Rate/Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2027 (CUSIP 316773 DD9). The cash redemption price equals principal plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the November 1, 2026 redemption date, one year before scheduled maturity. Interest ceases accruing on the redemption date; no notes remain outstanding thereafter. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation.
